Many websites and applications today are using PHP because of its functionality and convenience. There is a strong needed for the skilled coders, so to hire dedicated PHP developers is an in-demand request, and PHP programmers salary is correspondingly high. So, let’s have a closer look at this programming language.

Hypertext Preprocessor language is enclosed into HTML web scripting, so it can be easily integrated into the web page. Coders use it for the creation of the dynamically generated pages and websites, driven by databases. It is secure to access databases on it because a user cannot view the initial code – it is transformed into HTML before the page loaded.

The syntax of PHP is partially borrowed from Java, C, and Perl, but it also has many individual features. Developers love it for being simple for the beginners and having many interesting advanced options. What can you do on PHP? Almost anything. Traditionally it is used for server-side scripting, but you can also write a script, run without server or browser – command line scripting. The experienced developers even write desktop and cross-platform applications, using the advanced features of the language. PHP is widely used in the applications for Microsoft Windows, Linux, Unix, macOS, and RISC OS. It is also supported by most servers.

PHP Programmers Salary: How Much Does It Cost

PHP is a popular programming language for the creation of the functional and highly featured web pages and applications. And as any branch of the web development, it is not cheap. However, PHP programmers salary significantly differs depending on the location of the coder. For example, PHP developer Germany salary is much higher than in Ukraine or other countries of Eastern Europe. So, how much does it cost to hire the coder in different countries?

According to the British website CvJobs, PHP developer UK salary ranges from ￡37 500 to ￡57 500 for the coders, working permanently. The average annual amount is ￡47 500, which is about $61 000. But if the developer works on the contract basis, the professional earns ￡99 009 annually – about $127 000.

PHP developer salary Switzerland ranges from CHF 4 055 to CHF 188 359 per year, as claims PayScale. The average annual pay for the developer is CHF 75 000, which is about $76 355. Coders. located in the capital – Zurich – earn more than the devs from other regions. According to PayScale, PHP developer Germany salary average is €44 431 – about $51 213. The payment ranges from €29 000 to €59 000. Hourly rate is from €13 to €59. The coders get up to €4 500 bonus in a year. The highest fees are in Frankfurt am Mein and Munich.

In the USA an average salary PHP programmer is $88 978 per year, according to the information from Indeed.com. It ranges from $29 000 to $180 000. The highest rates are for the coders living in Los Angeles – $116 146, the second place takes New York with $104 184 per year.

What is a PHP developer salary in Canada? Median for this position is $97 500 per year or $50 per hour, according to the information from neuvoo.ca. Junior specialists earn about $48 150 annually, while experienced senior level coders make up to $156 000.

In Ukraine, the average salary of the PHP developer is $22 000 per year, as we know from PayScale. The payment ranges from $11 890 to $44 400 annually. Coders receive about $325 bonus for this period. The most expensive developers live in Kyiv. The second place takes Charkiv.

In web development, there is no need for a coder to work in the office. You can easily hire the remote performer from anywhere, choosing by the skills. It is also not a cheap option for a company – to launch web application or website, as PHP programming salary is usually high. So it is useful to have a possibility of reducing the expenses and offshore php application development. For example, in Ukraine, you can hire skilled and experienced coders cheaper, than in most European and North American countries.

PHP Developer Resume – How Should It Look Like?

Educational Background

PHP developer resume should include info about a Bachelor’s or higher degree in fields, related to web and software development with the usage of PHP scripting and related tools – Web Development, Web Design, Computer Sciences, Engineering, etc. Diplomas and certificates of different courses are welcomed.

Skills

Candidate’s online resume of PHP developers includes skills such as:

  • Experience of work as a PHP programmer.
  • Ability to implement various databases and data sources into one product.
  • Knowledge in front-end technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery. Ability to hand-code it.
  • Understanding the behavior of the programming language and its limitations.
  • Strong knowledge of the fundamental design principles and experience in scalable application building.
  • Experience of work with open-source frameworks: Joomla, osCommerce, Wikis, and others.
  • Knowledge of the related tools, databases, and web services for the developers.

Responsibilities

  • Writing of a well-designed code without bugs.
  • Testing and documentation of the software for client’s apps.
  • Optimization and troubleshooting of the product and its databases for functionality.
  • Implementation of data-storage solutions: blob stores, key-value stores, databases, etc.
  • Usage of visual development environments and debuggers if needed.
